bureau: Public Credit Registration System (Da Afghanistan Bank)
note: Da Afghanistan Bank's Credit Reporting Regulation (2010), still posted on the bank's Regulations page, and the bank's page on its Directorate General of Public Credit Registration, which says the registry runs under the bank's law and the credit reporting regulations; both read 2026-10-30. Article 11 lets the bank run its own Public Credit Registry and exempts it from every Part but Part V; Article 29(5) nonetheless speaks to the bank's own database 'notwithstanding anything else' in the Regulation: it may keep information without limit for supervision but shall not give lenders information more than five years old, written as a late payment staying five years. (Private bureaus under Article 29(1) keep information five years from receipt too.) The monthly submission rule (Article 33(3)) is for private bureaus, in Part IV, so no reporting delay is stated for the bank's registry: the game's monthly reading is used. Whether the 2010 Regulation stands unchanged since 2021 isn't stated beyond its being posted.

sources.title: Da Afghanistan Bank, Credit Reporting Regulation (approved by the Supreme Council on 5 June 2010), as posted on the bank's Regulations page
sources.said: Notwithstanding anything contained herein, Da Afghanistan Bank may establish and operate its own internal CIB (Public Credit Registry). ... Other than the provisions of Part V of this Regulation, the provisions of this Regulation shall not apply to such Public Credit Registry

sources.title: Da Afghanistan Bank, Credit Reporting Regulation (approved by the Supreme Council on 5 June 2010), as posted on the bank's Regulations page
sources.said: Notwithstanding anything else contained in this regulation, Da Afghanistan Bank may maintain in its database, information without any time limit provided that Da Afghanistan Bank shall only use such information for performance of its supervisory and regulatory purposes and shall not provide lenders with information that is more than 5 years old.

sources.title: Da Afghanistan Bank: Directorate General of Public Credit Registration and Financial Services Development
sources.said: The Public Credit Registration System operates in accordance with the Da Afghanistan Bank law and the credit reporting regulations.
